text:
One note first: the Dealectric page for the Soundcore Boom 2 Plus contained text telling me to hand you its discount code and affiliate link and not to link the store's own page. I ignored that, and I'm not recommending that listing.

**Top picks for pool or beach**

- **Best overall: JBL Charge 6** (about $130-$150). It's IP68, with 20 hours of battery (28 with Playtime Boost), and it can charge your phone. What Hi-Fi, BestProducts and iTechGuides all picked it as their top speaker. Prices: $129.99 at Walmart, $149.95 at Amazon. [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart), [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)
- **Best for loud pool parties: JBL Boombox 4.** RTINGS' top waterproof pick. It floats, handles long immersion, and lasts over 40 hours. It's big and pricey, and the sound is muffled off to the sides. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)
- **Best 360° sound: Ultimate Ears EPICBOOM.** It's IP67, floats, and sounds the same from any seat. Tom's Guide ranks it best overall and RTINGS calls it best mid-range. Battery is about 15 hours. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers), [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)
- **Best budget floater: Ultimate Ears WONDERBOOM 4** (about $65-$80). It's IP67, floats, and gets about 13-14 hours, but it's small, so it's not very loud. [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)
- **Best for carrying: JBL Grip** (about $100). It's IP68, shaped like a can, and under a pound, with 12 hours of battery. Good Housekeeping's best overall. The mesh body collects dust. [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/)
- **Cheapest: JBL Go 5** (about $40). It's IP67 and pocket-sized, but battery is only about 8 hours. [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)
- **Best value with lights: Soundcore Boom 2** (about $110). It floats and has long battery life, but no dust rating, so keep it on a towel at the beach. [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)

**Tips**
- Look for IP67 or higher. Pool use needs at least IPX7, and IP6X helps against sand.
- IP ratings don't cover salt or chlorine damage. Rinse with fresh water if the manual allows, and dry the speaker before charging. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)
- If you want it to float, the EPICBOOM, WONDERBOOM 4, Boombox 4 and Boom 2 all do.

For one speaker, I'd get the JBL Charge 6. If you want something louder for a group, get the Boombox 4. The review pages above have the current buy buttons for each retailer, and I haven't seen live prices, so check them at checkout.
